text:
Predicates:
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(x, y) ::: x begins with number y.
Plate(x) ::: x is a vehicle registration plate.
Vehicle(x) ::: x is a vehicle.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
FromIstanbulPlate(x) ::: x is a plate from Istanbul.
Premises:
∀x (Plate(x) ∧ FromIstanbulPlate(x) → BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: All plates from Istanbul begin with 34.
∀x (Plate(x) ∧ ¬FromIstanbulPlate(x) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: Plates not from Istanbul do not begin with 34.
FromIstanbulPlate(Joe'sPlate) ::: Joe's plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(Tom'sPlate, 35) ::: Tom's plate begins with 35.
∀x (BeginsWith(x, 35) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: If a plate begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.
Conclusion:
FromIstanbulPlate(Tom'sPlate) ::: Tom's plate is from Istanbul.
